newsitem.title: USA: Florida housing bonds yield 8.375 pct in 2018.
newsitem.headline: Florida housing bonds yield 8.375 pct in 2018.

text.p: First Union Capital Markets Corp said Thursday it priced $19 million Florida Housing Finance Agency multifamily housing bonds to yield 8.375 percent in the 2018 AMT portion.
A PRO-RATA PORTION OF ALL AOUTSTANDING BONDS

WILL BE SUBJECT TO A ONE-TIME SPECIAL REDEMPTION ON 7/1/00 IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $500,00 FROM THE LEASE-UP RESERVE FUND (SEE "SECURITY AND SOURCE OF REPAYMENT") HELD BY THE TRUSTEE UNDER THE INDENTURE, IN ORDER TO CONTINUE TO MEET CASH FLOW REQUIREMENTS SPECIFIED BY S&P, IF THE PROPERTY SHOULD NOT ACHIEVE THE 94% SUSTAINED OCCUPANCY AND 1.50x DEBT SERVICE COVERAGE OF THE SENIOR LIEN BONDS BY THAT DATE.
ALL BONDS ARE PRICED AT PAR.
THE SERIES B BONDS WILL BE SUBJECT TO A

ONE-TIME MANDATORY PRINCIPAL ABATEMENT PAYMENT ON 7/1/98, IN THE AMOUNT OF $350,000. A PRO-RATA PORTION OF ALL OUTSTANDING BONDS WILL BE SUJECT TO A ONE-TIME SPECIAL REDEMPTION OF 7/1/00 IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $500,000 FROM THE LEASE-UP RESERVE FUND (SEE "SECURITY AND SOURCE OF REPAYMENT") HELD BY THE TRUSTEE UNDER THE INDENTURE, IN ORDER TO CONTINUE TO MEET CASH FLOW REQUIREMENTS SPECIFIED BY S&P, IF THE PROPERTY SHOULD NOT ACHIEVE THE 94% SUSTAINED OCCUPANCY AND 1.50x DEBT SERVICE COVERAGE OF THE SENIOR LIEN BONDS BY THAT DATE.
The compliance addendum MSRB Rule G-11 will apply.
This issue is not book entry.
This issue is clearing through DTC.
